items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Well, at that time, they had, uh, Durand and Umphrey band... Well, which, which Humphrey was that? Oh, that was way back, I was a youngster then... Willie's- Willie and Percy's father?

ctx.x: I could be wrong, you know, but I just thought, he told me about playing in some dive. That might have been before your time, though. I didn't.

Yeah. But, I don't know anything about that, because I never know them to have anything on Brooklyn Street. Well, it seems to me, tell me, here, the men went back down there. The only thing I can remember over here, in my time, we had, uh, the Young Men Hall back here, we had the Belleville Park over here on Belleville Street. Well, at that time, they had, uh, Durand and Umphrey band, uh, Peter was playing, Peter was playing fiddle at that time, playing violin. Well, which, which Humphrey was that? Oh, that was…
Yeah. Was Willie and Percy's father in that band or was it-
